correctness.rationale: The exact conditional fixed-site mean follows from a bounded backward-equation solution and cycle renewal. Tonelli gives an exact nonnegative generating series; radius-domain cases are explicit. Derivative N'(y)=(y-1)[2A'(y)+yA''(y)] is strictly positive whenever P(J>=2)>0. All endpoints (including finite moment at R with N(R)<=0) and J=1 degenerate case are treated. The boundary sign is proved by exact rational bounds. The rare-mixture exponent and coefficient follow from a positive-leading-coefficient polynomial root and asymptotic substitution; independent finite-volume and randomized numerical checks passed.

value.rationale: Population-mean search under a fixed but uncertain starting/reset distance is physically motivated and not interchangeable with fresh-site resetting. The complete optimization classification reveals when a finite optimum is interior versus forced to a moment-integrability boundary, and the universal fractional rare-site law quantifies sharp sensitivity of the optimal rate to the most remote populated class. These provide structural knowledge and robustness thresholds not obtainable by independently tuning every individual starting site.
